context: 3 DOSAGE FORMS AND STRENGTHS Fluzone Quadrivalent is an injectable suspension. For individuals 6 months through 35 months, a single dose is 0.25 mL or 0.5 mL. For individuals 36 months and older, a single dose is 0.5 mL.
